name: 暗骨片与断索前景
pivotSuggestion: top-center for hanging pieces; contact top-center for terrain; center for landmarks
qaFindings: 暗色骨片与旧绳连接成前景件，无独立新道具；局部骨顶仍有亮边，放置于遮挡层时检查是否误认平台。
需root完成统一比例、透明深浅底和确定性房间合成验收；未作为已验收入库。

generationRequest.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated 2D game environment sprite on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, reference-guided redraw. Image1 supplies intended organ material and shape language; Image2 is the established delivered asset's matte gouache, clean dark ink contours, fine hand-painted texture and side-view only, do not copy its anatomy. Side-scrolling camera, very slight top-face visibility only where appropriate. Draw one complete coherent object with about 8% clear transparent padding, no scene, no floating multiple objects, no contact shadow or colored haze outside the silhouette. Full object uncropped. No characters, creatures, shelters, lamps, red ropes, rewards, symbols, labels, UI, ground patch, water or backdrop. No human stonework or invented portals.  Subject: ONE low connected arrangement of overlapping weathered bone fragments bound by a single short broken old cord, a dark BOTTOM FOREGROUND border for R4. Broad irregular strip with two blunt protruding tips; dark indigo-gray and charcoal bone with faint subdued ivory-gray texture only, the cord is very dark desaturated burgundy and sits attached across the bone, no hanging ring. Very low contrast silhouette, no bright continuous top edge, no readable platform, no massive spikes, no human skull, no complete skeleton, no vegetation. One coherent framing component 14 hero units wide, all pieces touching or joined, whole shape contained with transparent padding.

method: 内置 imagegen 逐件生成或参考引导静态状态修改；原始 PNG 未裁切、降噪或抠图。
